standard_prerequisites.name: Decency local on the target
standard_prerequisites.use: Decency pulls back along etale morphisms.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine etale cover U -> X; decency pulls back so the fibres are finite sets of points.
Run the Noetherian factorization argument on the finite fibre.
Glue the factorization over the etale cover; descent of morphisms along etale surjections gives the global factorization.
proof_roadmap: Etale reduction; finite-fibre factorization; descent glue.
difficulty_reason: A descent argument reducing to the carded Noetherian case.
